name: Signal
summary: Signal has no official bot API, so agents usually run signal-cli, an unofficial client that registers or links a phone number and exposes command-line, JSON-RPC and D-Bus interfaces. The agent then sends and receives end-to-end encrypted messages like any Signal user. It suits personal or small-group agents rather than business messaging.
facts: No official bot API; unofficial signal-cli
Free; needs a phone number to register
goodFor: Private personal agents with end-to-end encryption
watchOut: Unofficial; releases older than three months may stop working
Registering a number can unregister its existing client
